holdout_validation.rule: median IC <= 0 on the decide half
holdout_validation.metric: long_short_tstat and top_decile_alpha, measured on the held-out half
holdout_validation.verdicts_scope: both_halves_stability — the decide-half rule is NOT applied (audit B8); see oos_verdicts for the rule-gated protocol
holdout_validation.oos_verdicts_scope: rule-gated out-of-sample — only directions whose decide half flagged the theme carry evidence (audit B8)

costs.cost_model: one-way bps by point-in-time market cap; see COST_BPS_BY_MKTCAP

cost_model_limitations: keyed on point-in-time market cap ONLY — no spread, no average daily volume, no price level, no participation rate
